# CITY OF GLOUCESTER

## Gloucester Historical Commission

October 26, 2026, at 6:30 – 8:30 PM

Rose Baker Senior Center, 2nd floor conference room

6 Manuel F. Lewis Street, Gloucester, MA 01930

Join from PC, Mac, iPad, or Android: https://gloucester-ma-gov.zoom.us/j/81653439506 WEB ID: 81653439506

## ADMINISTRATION

## PRESERVATION RESTRICTIONS

- Three new in 2026,(Riggs House, Wm Haskell House, Tucker House-Hayden Cottage)
- Susan added to our Gloucester Designations list; Ralph posted to website

## HISTORIC HOUSE PLAQUES (Susan)

- **Sept-Oct NEW PLAQUES:**
  - 1206 Washington St (Moses Parsons, Yeoman, 1834)
  - 5 Wiley St (East Gloucester Yacht Club, 1901-1918) approved 8/31/26
  - 34-36 Summer St (Unitarian Parsonage, 1917-1939) approved 8/31/26
  - 11 Pirates Lane (NSAA, Est. 1922) and (Wonson Wharf c1885 ) approved 8/31/26
- **Possible new applicants:**
  - 150 Leonard St, Annisquam application underway, not yet finished
  - 28 Friend St (Eben Brown, Master Mariner, R1851) approved 8/31/26
  - 9 Hickory St (1866, not in MACRIS) application request 9/24

- Recent work/submissions

- QR code project, Tim to work with high school students on QR code for marker posts and affixing the signs to the posts.

## 2027 PRESERVATION AWARDS (Bob and Ralph)

- Bob – list of current list of nominees
- Ralph - book 1623 Studios for filming

- Brief update of the 10 applicants requesting historic funding

## REGISTER OF HISTORIC BUILDINGS (Susan/Julie)

- Central database for the city of all historic buildings
- *1900 and 1920 year of build was arbitrarily assigned, these are being newly researched + corrected*
  - Russell & Melissa Hobbs - 126 Lanesville houses built 1900 per city
  - Stephanie Buck - 3,230 Gloucester houses built before 1900 per city
- Will use library software to create an Omeka database (https://omeka.org/)
  - Will be live on / be posted to library website

## ROCKY NECK CULTURAL CENTER - Historic Art Trail (Susan)

https://www.rockyneckartcolony.org/historic-art-trail

- Online self-guided walking tour of 15 historic sites; provides in-depth history and photos of each site
- 9/8/26 RNAC volunteered to let GHC add additional historic sites to their website/tour
- GHC will not be posting historic building documentation here, per Julie

## CERTIFIED LOCAL GOVERNMENT STATUS (Susan)

- 9/5/26 + 9/11/26 Susan emailed Michael Steinitz, State Historic Preservation Officer inquiring about our 2023, 2024, 2025 annual reports in arrears
- 9/29 emailed Manchester and Salem, no reply, did not pursue
- Gloucester still listed as a CLG per invite for a grant

## FUNDING FOR LANESVILLE/Lane's Cove NATIONAL REGISTRY DISTRICT APPLICATION (Ralph)

- Focus is on a smaller area of Lanesville center, which includes Lane's Cove, the Fish Shack, cemetery and a few smaller buildings surrounding that area that are publicly owned; if privately owned, Ralph will speak with directly.
  - The fish shacks, seawall, and cemetery would qualify for grants to repair them if NR was passed.
- Ralph ltr 8/20/26 to MHC seeking approval for nomination; Ben Haley/Nat Reg Dir-MHC replied 8/24/26
- Ralph is seeking funding based on Wendy's estimate of $7,000 for smaller-area project
- **FUNDING OPPORTUNITY: 2027 MHC Survey and Planning Grant**

## LANES COVE PLAQUE (Ralph)

- Update
